newsitem.title: PERU: Peru receives three bids for fish plant sale.
newsitem.headline: Peru receives three bids for fish plant sale.

text.p: Peru's state fishing company Pescaperu said Thursday it had received three bids from local firms in the auction of its Tambo de Mora fishing plant, which has a minimum bid price of $4.2 million.
Pescaperu officials added they received no bids for two fishing refineries, Pescaperu Refineria de Pisco and Pescaperu Refineria Supe, which were also put up for auction Thursday.
The state company said the three firms bidding for the plant at Tambo, 125 miles (200 km) south of Lima, were Poseidon S.A., Pesquera Industrial el Angel S.A. and Pesquera Maria del Milagro S.L.R..
Pescaperu plans to announce the auction winner August 4.
The government has received $100 million from the sale of state fishing assets since it began the sector's privatization in 1994.
